title: repo-sync consumer manifest
description: Generated by StottHoare/repo-sync. Do not edit by hand.

languages.description: Languages this repo participates in. Mutually exclusive within a family (<family>-<version>).

exclude-files.description: Opt out of specific files that an included language would otherwise provide.

src.description: Filename as listed in the language manifest (relative to languages/<lang>/files/).

gitignore.description: Override default gitignore handling. Each entry produces a separate <destination>/.gitignore.

destination.description: Subdirectory in the consumer where this language gitignore lands.
